posts.name: Pancakesause
posts.cooked:
Hello,

This bug with Codex has been reported on the Wowhead post last patch and I can personally confirm it still exists today. Wowhead page: https://www.wowhead.com/item=185836/codex-of-the-first-technique?bonus=6805#comments

A simple misclick or a tab target to a mob on the opposite side of the dungeon with the buff active will almost always immediately aggro the mob regardless of range.

The trinket shouldn’t be able to reflect damage to an entity you are not in combat with.
